一举两得.meaning: 做一件事得到两方面的好处。
一举两得.en: kill two birds with one stone
一举两得.sentence: 边散步边背单词，真是一举两得。
一举两得.sentenceEn: Memorizing words while walking really kills two birds with one stone.

一劳永逸.meaning: 辛苦一次，把事情办好，以后不再费力。
一劳永逸.sentence: 想一劳永逸地解决问题，往往并不现实。
一劳永逸.sentenceEn: Hoping to solve a problem once and for all is often unrealistic.

一向.meaning: 从过去到现在都是这样。
一向.sentence: 他一向待人诚恳，从不计较得失。
一向.sentenceEn: He has always treated people sincerely and never fusses over gains.

一味.meaning: 单纯地，一个劲儿地（多含贬义）。
一味.sentence: 学习不能一味死记硬背，要讲究方法。
一味.sentenceEn: In study one mustn't just rote-learn blindly; method matters.

一帆风顺.meaning: 比喻非常顺利，没有任何挫折。
一帆风顺.sentence: 人生不可能一帆风顺，挫折在所难免。
一帆风顺.sentenceEn: Life can't always be smooth sailing; setbacks are inevitable.

一心一意.sentence: 他一心一意地投入学习，不受外界干扰。
一心一意.sentenceEn: He devoted himself wholeheartedly to study, undistracted.

一日千里.sentence: 近年来，科技发展一日千里，日新月异。
一日千里.sentenceEn: In recent years technology has advanced by leaps and bounds.

一旦.meaning: 表示假设，有一天，忽然有一天。
一旦.sentence: 机会一旦错过，就很难再有了。
一旦.sentenceEn: Once the chance is missed, it's hard to come by again.

一模一样.sentence: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样，常常让人认错。
一模一样.sentenceEn: The twins look exactly alike and are often mistaken for each other.

一般.sentence: 这本书的内容比较一般，没有特别出彩的地方。
一般.sentenceEn: This book's content is rather ordinary, with nothing outstanding.

一见如故.meaning: 初次见面就像老朋友一样。
一见如故.sentence: 两人一见如故，很快成了无话不谈的朋友。
一见如故.sentenceEn: The two hit it off at once and soon became close friends.

一蹶不振.meaning: 一次受挫，就再也振作不起来。
一蹶不振.sentence: 输掉比赛后，他一度一蹶不振，后来才重拾信心。
一蹶不振.sentenceEn: After losing, he was crushed for a while before regaining confidence.

一鸣惊人.meaning: 平时没有突出表现，一下子做出惊人成绩。
一鸣惊人.sentence: 这名新人在比赛中一鸣惊人，夺得了冠军。
一鸣惊人.sentenceEn: The newcomer amazed everyone in the contest and won the title.

上演.sentence: 这部话剧将于下周在剧院上演。
上演.sentenceEn: The play will be staged at the theatre next week.

不仅.sentence: 他不仅成绩好，而且乐于助人。
不仅.sentenceEn: Not only are his grades good, but he is also helpful.

不以为然.meaning: 不认为是对的，表示不同意。
不以为然.sentence: 对于他的看法，大家都不以为然。

不假思索.meaning: 做事或回答十分迅速，用不着考虑。
不假思索.en: Without the slightest hesitation; without a moment's thought.
不假思索.sentence: 老师一提问，他不假思索地举手回答。
不假思索.sentenceEn: The moment the teacher asked, he raised his hand and answered without hesitation.

不可思议.sentence: 他竟然在一夜之间完成了任务，简直不可思议。
不可思议.sentenceEn: He actually finished the task overnight — simply inconceivable.

不可或缺.sentence: 水和空气是维持生命不可或缺的条件。
不可或缺.sentenceEn: Water and air are indispensable conditions for sustaining life.

不妨.meaning: 表示可以这样做，没有什么妨碍。
不妨.sentence: 如果拿不定主意，不妨先听听别人的建议。
不妨.sentenceEn: If you can't decide, you might as well hear others' suggestions first.

不屈不挠.meaning: 形容意志坚强，不向困难低头。
不屈不挠.sentence: 面对接连的失败，他依然不屈不挠，奋力向前。
不屈不挠.sentenceEn: Despite repeated failures, he remained unyielding and pressed on.

不懈.sentence: 经过不懈的努力，他终于取得了成功。
不懈.sentenceEn: Through unremitting effort, he finally succeeded.

不时.sentence: 他一边走，一边不时回头张望。
不时.sentenceEn: As he walked, he glanced back from time to time.

不止.meaning: 超出某个数目或范围；不停止。
不止.sentence: 参加比赛的不止他一个人，还有许多同学。
不止.sentenceEn: He wasn't the only one in the contest; many classmates joined too.

不然.sentence: 幸好他提醒了我，不然我就忘了这件事。
不然.sentenceEn: Luckily he reminded me, otherwise I'd have forgotten this.

不甘示弱.meaning: 不甘心表示自己比别人差。
不甘示弱.sentence: 看到对手领先，他不甘示弱，奋起直追。
不甘示弱.sentenceEn: Seeing his rival ahead, he refused to be outdone and gave chase.

不管.meaning: 表示在任何条件下结果都不变（无论）。
不管.sentence: 不管遇到什么困难，他都不会轻易放弃。
不管.sentenceEn: No matter what difficulties he meets, he won't give up easily.

不约而同.meaning: 事先没有约定而彼此一致。
不约而同.sentence: 听到这个消息，大家不约而同地欢呼起来。
不约而同.sentenceEn: At the news, everyone cheered as if by prior agreement.

不胜枚举.meaning: 无法一个一个全举出来，形容数量很多。
不胜枚举.sentence: 他乐于助人的事例不胜枚举。
不胜枚举.sentenceEn: Examples of him helping others are too numerous to list.

不自量力.meaning: 过高地估计自己的力量。
不自量力.sentence: 明知实力悬殊还要硬拼，未免有些不自量力。
不自量力.sentenceEn: Knowing the gap in strength yet forcing it on is overrating oneself.

不解之缘.meaning: 不能分开的缘分，多指深厚关系。
不解之缘.sentence: 他从小喜爱绘画，与艺术结下了不解之缘。
不解之缘.sentenceEn: Loving painting since childhood, he formed an indissoluble bond with art.

不辞辛劳.sentence: 为了完成任务，他不辞辛劳，日夜奔波。
不辞辛劳.sentenceEn: To finish the task he spared no effort, rushing about day and night.

不闻不问.meaning: 既不打听，也不过问，形容漠不关心。
不闻不问.en: show no interest; not bother about
不闻不问.sentence: 他对邻居的困难不闻不问，显得十分冷漠。
不闻不问.sentenceEn: He paid no attention to his neighbour's troubles, seeming quite cold.

与其.meaning: 比较两件事而取舍时，用在舍弃的一面。
与其.sentence: 与其抱怨环境，不如努力改变自己。
与其.sentenceEn: Rather than complain about your circumstances, better to change yourself.

专心致志.sentence: 他专心致志地做实验，连有人进来都没察觉。
专心致志.sentenceEn: He worked on the experiment so intently he didn't notice someone enter.

世外桃源.meaning: 比喻不受外界干扰的理想境地。
世外桃源.sentence: 这个小山村宁静优美，宛如世外桃源。
世外桃源.sentenceEn: The quiet, beautiful mountain village was like a haven of peace.

丢失.sentence: 他不小心丢失了那把重要的钥匙。
丢失.sentenceEn: He carelessly lost that important key.

严肃.sentence: 会议气氛十分严肃，没有人随意说话。
严肃.sentenceEn: The atmosphere of the meeting was very solemn; no one spoke casually.

丧失.sentence: 一次失败不该让你丧失信心。
丧失.sentenceEn: One failure shouldn't make you lose confidence.

丰富.meaning: （种类多、数量大）；也作动词，使丰富。
丰富.sentence: 阅读课外书能丰富我们的知识。
丰富.sentenceEn: Reading extracurricular books enriches our knowledge.

乏味.sentence: 这堂课内容乏味，同学们都昏昏欲睡。
乏味.sentenceEn: The lesson was so dull the students grew drowsy.

争夺.sentence: 两队为争夺冠军展开了激烈的较量。
争夺.sentenceEn: The two teams fought fiercely for the championship.

于是.meaning: 表示后一事紧接前一事（顺承）。
于是.sentence: 天突然下起了雨，于是大家纷纷躲进屋里。
于是.sentenceEn: It suddenly began to rain, so everyone hurried indoors.

五彩缤纷.sentence: 花园里五彩缤纷的花朵竞相开放。
五彩缤纷.sentenceEn: In the garden, flowers of every colour vied to bloom.

交流.sentence: 通过这次活动，两校学生增进了交流。
交流.sentenceEn: Through this event, students from both schools deepened their exchanges.

产生.meaning: 由已有事物中生出新的事物。
产生.sentence: 长期的误会使两人产生了隔阂。
产生.sentenceEn: The long misunderstanding bred an estrangement between them.

享受.meaning: 物质或精神上得到满足。
享受.sentence: 工作之余，他喜欢享受片刻的宁静。
享受.sentenceEn: After work, he liked to enjoy a moment of quiet.

享有.meaning: 在社会上取得（权利、声誉等）。
享有.sentence: 这位作家在文坛享有很高的声誉。
享有.sentenceEn: The writer enjoys a high reputation in literary circles.

亲近.sentence: 老师和蔼可亲，学生都喜欢亲近他。
亲近.sentenceEn: The teacher was kind, and the students liked being close to him.

从容.sentence: 面对记者的提问，他从容应答，毫不紧张。
从容.sentenceEn: Facing the reporters' questions, he answered calmly, unfazed.

以致.meaning: 由于上文原因而造成的结果（多指不好的）。
以致.en: so that; with the result that
以致.sentence: 他平时不努力，以致考试不及格。
以致.sentenceEn: He didn't work hard, so he failed the exam.

优美.sentence: 公园里景色优美，吸引了许多游客。
优美.sentenceEn: The scenery in the park is beautiful and draws many visitors.

伟业.sentence: 无数先辈为国家的伟业奉献了一生。
伟业.sentenceEn: Countless forebears devoted their lives to the nation's great cause.

似曾相识.sentence: 这个地方似曾相识，却又想不起在哪儿见过。
似曾相识.sentenceEn: The place seemed familiar, yet he couldn't recall where he'd seen it.

似笑非笑.meaning: 像笑又不像笑，形容神情微妙。
似笑非笑.sentence: 他似笑非笑地看着我，让人摸不透心思。
似笑非笑.sentenceEn: He looked at me with a faint, ambiguous smile, hard to read.

体会.sentence: 亲身经历之后，他才真正体会到父母的辛劳。
体会.sentenceEn: Only after experiencing it himself did he grasp his parents' toil.

体谅.meaning: 设身处地为人着想，给以谅解。
体谅.sentence: 母亲工作辛苦，我们应该多体谅她。
体谅.sentenceEn: Mother works hard, so we should be more understanding toward her.

何况.meaning: 用反问表示更进一层（况且）。
何况.sentence: 这么难的题目连老师都答不出，何况是学生呢？
何况.sentenceEn: Even the teacher couldn't answer such a hard question, let alone a student.

何尝.meaning: 用反问表示未曾或并非（其实并不）。
何尝.sentence: 我何尝不想休息，只是任务还没完成。
何尝.sentenceEn: It's not that I don't want to rest — the task just isn't done.

例子.sentence: 老师举了一个生动的例子来解释这个道理。
例子.sentenceEn: The teacher gave a vivid example to explain the point.

依然.sentence: 时隔多年，他依然记得老师的教诲。
依然.sentenceEn: After all these years, he still remembers his teacher's lessons.

依照.sentence: 他依照老师的指导，认真完成了实验。
依照.sentenceEn: Following the teacher's guidance, he carefully completed the experiment.

依赖.meaning: 依靠别人或事物，不能自立。
依赖.sentence: 他过分依赖父母，缺乏独立生活的能力。
依赖.sentenceEn: He depended too much on his parents and lacked independence.

侵略.meaning: 用武力侵犯别国领土、主权等。
侵略.sentence: 面对外敌的侵略，军民奋起抵抗。
侵略.sentenceEn: Faced with foreign aggression, army and people rose to resist.

促进.sentence: 适当的运动能促进身体健康，增强体质。
促进.sentenceEn: Appropriate exercise promotes good health and builds fitness.

保存.meaning: 使事物、性质等不受损失。
保存.sentence: 这些古老的文物被完好地保存了下来。
保存.sentenceEn: These ancient relics have been preserved intact.

保留.meaning: 保存不变；暂时留着不处理。
保留.sentence: 尽管有不同意见，他还是保留了自己的看法。
保留.sentenceEn: Despite differing views, he retained his own opinion.

保证.sentence: 他向老师保证，今后一定按时完成作业。
保证.sentenceEn: He assured the teacher he would finish his homework on time from now on.

信念.meaning: 自己认为可以确信的看法。
信念.sentence: 凭着坚定的信念，他克服了重重困难。
信念.sentenceEn: With firm conviction, he overcame countless difficulties.

修改.meaning: 改正文章、计划等中的缺点。
修改.sentence: 这篇作文还需要进一步修改和完善。
修改.sentenceEn: This essay needs further revision and polishing.

偏偏.meaning: 表示故意跟客观要求或情况相反；偏要。
偏偏.sentence: 大家都劝他休息，他偏偏要继续工作。
偏偏.sentenceEn: Everyone urged him to rest, but he insisted on working.

偶像.sentence: 这位科学家是许多年轻人心中的偶像。
偶像.sentenceEn: This scientist is an idol to many young people.

偶尔.sentence: 他平时很少出门，偶尔才去公园散步。
偶尔.sentenceEn: He rarely goes out, only occasionally strolling in the park.

元素.sentence: 这部电影融入了许多中国传统文化元素。
元素.sentenceEn: The film incorporated many traditional Chinese cultural elements.

充实.sentence: 他的暑假生活过得十分充实而有意义。
充实.sentenceEn: He spent a full and meaningful summer holiday.

充沛.sentence: 他精力充沛，整天忙碌也不觉得累。
充沛.sentenceEn: He is full of energy and doesn't tire even after a busy day.

充满.sentence: 新年到来，大家心里充满了希望。
充满.sentenceEn: As the new year came, everyone's heart brimmed with hope.

全面.sentence: 看问题要全面，不能只看一个方面。
全面.sentenceEn: One must view things comprehensively, not from one side only.

关切.sentence: 老师对学生的成长十分关切。
关切.sentenceEn: The teacher is deeply concerned about the students' growth.

关注.sentence: 这个社会问题引起了人们的广泛关注。
关注.sentenceEn: This social issue drew widespread attention.

关键.meaning: 事物最关紧要的部分；起决定作用的因素。
关键.sentence: 坚持不懈是取得成功的关键。
关键.sentenceEn: Perseverance is the key to success.

兴盛.sentence: 在大家的努力下，这家企业日益兴盛。
兴盛.sentenceEn: With everyone's effort, the firm grew ever more prosperous.

兴致勃勃.meaning: 形容兴趣浓厚，情绪高涨。
兴致勃勃.sentence: 一听说要去郊游，孩子们个个兴致勃勃。
兴致勃勃.sentenceEn: At the news of the outing, the children were all in high spirits.

兴趣.sentence: 他对天文学有着浓厚的兴趣，常常观察星空。
兴趣.sentenceEn: He has a strong interest in astronomy and often observes the night sky.

其实.meaning: 表示所说的是实际情况（承上文转折）。
其实.sentence: 大家都以为他很严肃，其实他十分幽默。
其实.sentenceEn: Everyone thought he was serious; in fact he is very humorous.

养育.sentence: 父母养育子女，付出了无数的心血。
养育.sentenceEn: Parents pour endless effort into raising their children.

再三.sentence: 他再三叮嘱我，路上一定要小心。
再三.sentenceEn: He urged me again and again to be careful on the way.

再说.meaning: 进一步申说理由（而且）；以后再考虑。
再说.sentence: 现在天色已晚，再说路也不熟，我们改天再去吧。
再说.sentenceEn: It's late now; besides, we don't know the way, so let's go another day.

冒险.meaning: 不顾危险地进行某种活动。
冒险.sentence: 为了救人，他冒险跳进了湍急的河里。
冒险.sentenceEn: To save someone, he risked jumping into the rushing river.

决心.meaning: 坚定不移的意志；拿定主意。
决心.sentence: 他下定决心，一定要改掉拖延的坏习惯。
决心.sentenceEn: He resolved firmly to break his bad habit of procrastinating.

冷漠.sentence: 他对别人的困难态度冷漠，从不伸出援手。
冷漠.sentenceEn: He was indifferent to others' troubles and never lent a hand.

凋谢.sentence: 秋天来了，园中的花朵纷纷凋谢。
凋谢.sentenceEn: Autumn came, and the flowers in the garden withered one by one.

减轻.sentence: 适当休息可以减轻身体的疲劳。
减轻.sentenceEn: Proper rest can reduce physical fatigue.

凝视.sentence: 他凝视着远方，渐渐陷入了沉思。
凝视.sentenceEn: He gazed into the distance and gradually sank into thought.

分享.sentence: 他喜欢把读书的快乐与同学分享。
分享.sentenceEn: He liked to share the joy of reading with his classmates.

分散.meaning: 散开；使集中的事物分开。
分散.sentence: 嘈杂的环境容易分散他的注意力。
分散.sentenceEn: A noisy environment easily distracts his attention.

分歧.sentence: 两人在这个问题上存在着很大的分歧。
分歧.sentenceEn: The two differ greatly on this question.

创建.sentence: 他白手起家，创建了自己的公司。
创建.sentenceEn: Starting from scratch, he founded his own company.

初衷.sentence: 他始终没有忘记自己当老师的初衷。
初衷.sentenceEn: He never forgot his original intention of becoming a teacher.

判断.sentence: 面对复杂的局面，他冷静判断，做出了正确的选择。
判断.sentenceEn: Faced with a complex situation, he judged calmly and made the right choice.

到底.meaning: 究竟（追问）；终于；坚持到最后。
到底.sentence: 这件事到底是谁做的，至今没有人知道。
到底.sentenceEn: Who exactly did this, no one knows to this day.

制服.meaning: 用强力使驯服；制止使顺从。
制服.sentence: 警察很快制服了那名行凶的歹徒。
制服.sentenceEn: The police quickly subdued the assailant.

刻意.sentence: 他刻意隐瞒了事情的真相。
刻意.sentenceEn: He deliberately concealed the truth of the matter.

刻苦耐劳.en: hardworking and able to endure hardship
刻苦耐劳.sentence: 他刻苦耐劳，再累的活也从不抱怨。
刻苦耐劳.sentenceEn: He is hardworking and never complains, however tiring the job.

前仆后继.meaning: 前面的倒下，后面的跟上，形容奋勇向前。
前仆后继.sentence: 无数志士前仆后继，为理想英勇奋斗。
前仆后继.sentenceEn: Countless patriots pressed on wave upon wave, fighting for their ideals.

剩余.sentence: 请把剩余的材料收好，留着下次再用。
剩余.sentenceEn: Please keep the leftover materials for next time.

力求.sentence: 他做事认真，力求做到尽善尽美。
力求.sentenceEn: He works conscientiously, striving for perfection.

劝导.sentence: 在老师的耐心劝导下，他认识到了自己的错误。
劝导.sentenceEn: Under the teacher's patient guidance, he recognized his mistake.

劣势.sentence: 比赛中我方一度处于劣势，但最终反败为胜。
劣势.sentenceEn: We were at a disadvantage for a while but finally turned defeat into victory.

动听.meaning: 听起来使人感动或喜欢。
动听.sentence: 她的歌声十分动听，赢得了阵阵掌声。
动听.sentenceEn: Her singing was so melodious it drew rounds of applause.

动用.sentence: 为了完成救援，他们动用了所有的设备。
动用.sentenceEn: To complete the rescue, they brought all their equipment to bear.

包容.sentence: 他心胸宽广，能够包容别人的缺点。
包容.sentenceEn: Broad-minded, he could tolerate others' shortcomings.

包装.meaning: 用纸、盒等把物品包裹起来。
包装.sentence: 这件礼物的包装十分精美。

化解.sentence: 经过老师耐心调解，两人之间的矛盾终于化解了。
化解.sentenceEn: After the teacher's patient mediation, the conflict between the two was finally resolved.

区别.meaning: 彼此不同的地方；加以分辨。
区别.sentence: 这两个词意思相近，但在用法上有明显的区别。
区别.sentenceEn: These two words are close in meaning but clearly differ in usage.

千变万化.sentence: 天上的云朵千变万化，十分好看。
千变万化.sentenceEn: The clouds in the sky are ever-changing and lovely to watch.

千姿百态.meaning: 形容姿态多种多样，各不相同。
千姿百态.en: In a great variety of poses; myriad forms.
千姿百态.sentence: 公园里的花朵千姿百态，美不胜收。
千姿百态.sentenceEn: The flowers in the park take on myriad forms, a feast for the eyes.

升华.meaning: 比喻事物的提高和精炼。
升华.sentence: 经历磨难后，他的思想得到了升华。
升华.sentenceEn: After hardship, his thinking was elevated.

单纯.sentence: 孩子的想法很单纯，不掺杂任何私心。
单纯.sentenceEn: The child's thinking is pure, free of any selfish motive.

占据.meaning: 用强力取得或保持（地域、地位等）。
占据.sentence: 这件事占据了他大部分的时间和精力。
占据.sentenceEn: This matter took up most of his time and energy.

压力.meaning: 制伏人的力量；负担、紧张。
压力.sentence: 面对升学的压力，他学会了自我调节。
压力.sentenceEn: Facing the pressure of further study, he learned to cope.

原则.sentence: 在大是大非面前，他从不违背自己的原则。
原则.sentenceEn: On matters of right and wrong, he never betrays his principles.

去除.sentence: 他下决心去除身上的种种坏毛病。
去除.sentenceEn: He resolved to get rid of all his bad habits.

参考.meaning: 利用有关材料帮助了解、研究。
参考.sentence: 写论文时，他参考了大量的文献资料。
参考.sentenceEn: In writing the paper, he consulted a great deal of literature.

反之.sentence: 努力就会进步，反之则会落后。
反之.sentenceEn: Work hard and you progress; conversely you fall behind.

反射.meaning: 光、声等遇到阻碍而折回。
反射.sentence: 平静的湖面反射出岸边的景物。
反射.sentenceEn: The calm lake reflected the scenery on the shore.

反悔.meaning: 对已说定的事后悔而不承认。
反悔.sentence: 他答应的事从不反悔，十分守信。
反悔.sentenceEn: He never goes back on his promises and is most trustworthy.

反抗.sentence: 面对压迫，人民终于奋起反抗。
反抗.sentenceEn: Faced with oppression, the people finally rose up in resistance.

反映.meaning: 把情况告诉上级；表现出。
反映.sentence: 这部小说真实地反映了当时的社会生活。
反映.sentenceEn: The novel faithfully reflects the social life of the time.

反省.meaning: 回想自己的言行，检查错误。
反省.sentence: 犯错之后，他静下心来认真反省。
反省.sentenceEn: After erring, he calmed down and reflected earnestly.

发热.en: give off heat; have a fever
发热.sentence: 这台机器长时间运转后会发热。
发热.sentenceEn: This machine gives off heat after running for a long time.

取代.sentence: 新技术逐渐取代了传统的生产方式。
取代.sentenceEn: New technology gradually replaced traditional production methods.

变迁.sentence: 几十年来，家乡发生了巨大的变迁。
变迁.sentenceEn: Over the decades, my hometown has undergone great changes.

古道热肠.meaning: 待人真诚、热情，乐于助人。
古道热肠.sentence: 这位老人古道热肠，邻里有事都爱找他帮忙。
古道热肠.sentenceEn: The old man is warm-hearted; neighbours turn to him for help.

只有.meaning: 表示必需的唯一条件（与“才”搭配）。
只有.sentence: 只有付出努力，才能取得成功。
只有.sentenceEn: Only by putting in effort can one succeed.

后果.sentence: 做事不考虑后果，往往会带来麻烦。
后果.sentenceEn: Acting without thinking of consequences often brings trouble.

向往.meaning: 因热爱而希望得到或达到。
向往.sentence: 他从小就向往着外面广阔的世界。
向往.sentenceEn: Since childhood he yearned for the wide world outside.

向来.sentenceEn: He has always been punctual and never late.

吞食.meaning: 整个或成块地咽下去；吞并。
吞食.sentence: 大鱼张开嘴，一口吞食了那条小鱼。
吞食.sentenceEn: The big fish opened its mouth and swallowed the small one whole.

否定.meaning: 不承认事物的存在或真实性。
否定.sentence: 我们不能因为一次失误就否定他全部的努力。
否定.sentenceEn: We can't negate all his effort over one slip.

否认.sentence: 面对确凿的证据，他无法否认自己的错误。
否认.sentenceEn: In the face of hard evidence, he couldn't deny his mistake.

听从.meaning: 接受意见、劝告并照着做。
听从.sentence: 他听从了父母的建议，选择继续深造。
听从.sentenceEn: He took his parents' advice and chose to study further.

启示.sentence: 这个寓言故事给了我们深刻的启示。
启示.sentenceEn: This fable gave us a profound revelation.

呈现.sentence: 雨过天晴，天边呈现出一道美丽的彩虹。
呈现.sentenceEn: After the rain, a beautiful rainbow appeared on the horizon.

告诫.meaning: 警告、劝诫（多用于上对下）。
告诫.sentence: 父亲再三告诫他，做人要诚实守信。
告诫.sentenceEn: His father repeatedly admonished him to be honest and trustworthy.

周遭.sentence: 他沉浸在书中，对周遭的一切都浑然不觉。
周遭.sentenceEn: Absorbed in his book, he was oblivious to all around him.

命运.meaning: 指生死、贫富和一切遭遇。
命运.sentence: 他不相信命运，坚信努力可以改变人生。
命运.sentenceEn: He doesn't believe in fate; he's convinced effort can change one's life.

和谐.sentence: 邻里之间互相帮助，关系十分和谐。
和谐.sentenceEn: Neighbours help one another, and relations are very harmonious.

品头论足.meaning: 对人对事说长道短，多方挑剔。
品头论足.sentence: 他总爱对别人品头论足，惹人反感。
品头论足.sentenceEn: He always nitpicks at others, which is off-putting.

品尝.sentence: 他细细品尝着这道菜，赞不绝口。
品尝.sentenceEn: He savoured the dish slowly, full of praise.

品评.sentence: 评委们仔细品评着每一件参赛作品。
品评.sentenceEn: The judges carefully appraised each entry.

哄堂大笑.meaning: 形容全屋子的人同时大笑。
哄堂大笑.en: the whole room bursts out laughing
哄堂大笑.sentence: 他幽默的话语逗得大家哄堂大笑。
哄堂大笑.sentenceEn: His humorous remarks set the whole room laughing.

响应.sentence: 他的倡议得到了大家的积极响应。
响应.sentenceEn: His proposal met with everyone's active response.

哭笑不得.meaning: 不知该哭还是该笑，形容处境尴尬。
哭笑不得.en: not know whether to laugh or cry
哭笑不得.sentence: 他闹出的笑话让人哭笑不得。
哭笑不得.sentenceEn: The blunder he made left people not knowing whether to laugh or cry.

喧哗.sentence: 图书馆里请勿大声喧哗，以免影响他人。
喧哗.sentenceEn: Please don't make a clamour in the library, lest you disturb others.

嘲讽.sentence: 面对别人的嘲讽，他不卑不亢，坦然处之。
嘲讽.sentenceEn: Faced with others' mockery, he stayed composed and unruffled.

回复.sentence: 收到来信后，他很快做了回复。
回复.sentenceEn: After receiving the letter, he replied promptly.

回馈.sentence: 他事业成功后，不忘回馈社会。
回馈.sentenceEn: After succeeding, he didn't forget to give back to society.

困境.sentence: 公司陷入财务困境，员工们都很担忧。
困境.sentenceEn: The company fell into financial difficulty, and the staff were all anxious.

围绕.sentence: 这次讨论围绕环保这一主题展开。
围绕.sentenceEn: The discussion centred on the theme of environmental protection.

固定.sentence: 他每天都在固定的时间起床和睡觉。
固定.sentenceEn: He gets up and sleeps at fixed times every day.

固然.meaning: 表示承认某个事实，以引起下文转折。
固然.en: Admittedly; it is true that (… but).
固然.sentence: 天分固然重要，但勤奋更不可缺少。
固然.sentenceEn: Talent is admittedly important, but diligence is even more indispensable.

在意.sentence: 他从不在意别人的眼光，只做自己认为对的事。
在意.sentenceEn: He never cared about others' opinions and only did what he felt was right.

坎坷.meaning: 道路高低不平；比喻人生不顺利。
坎坷.sentence: 他的一生充满坎坷，却始终保持乐观。
坎坷.sentenceEn: His life was full of hardships, yet he stayed optimistic.

坚固.sentence: 这座桥梁建造得十分坚固，能承受很大的重量。
坚固.sentenceEn: The bridge was built very sturdily and can bear great weight.

坚定.meaning: 立场、意志稳定坚强，不动摇。
坚定.sentence: 无论别人怎么说，他的信念始终坚定。
坚定.sentenceEn: Whatever others said, his conviction remained firm.

坚强.sentence: 失去亲人后，她反而变得更加坚强。
坚强.sentenceEn: After losing a loved one, she grew even stronger.

坚韧不拔.sentence: 凭着坚韧不拔的毅力，他终于实现了目标。
坚韧不拔.sentenceEn: With indomitable willpower, he finally achieved his goal.

坦然.meaning: 心里平静，没有顾虑的样子。
坦然.sentence: 面对这次失败，他坦然接受，并从中吸取教训。
坦然.sentenceEn: Facing this failure, he accepted it calmly and learned from it.

埋怨.sentence: 计划失败后，他没有埋怨别人，只反省自己。
埋怨.sentenceEn: After the plan failed, he blamed no one and reflected on himself.

基本.sentence: 掌握基本的语法知识，对学习语言很重要。
基本.sentenceEn: Mastering basic grammar is important for learning a language.

增加.sentence: 随着年龄的增长，他的责任也在不断增加。
增加.sentenceEn: As he grows older, his responsibilities keep increasing.

增添.sentence: 几盆绿植为房间增添了不少生气。
增添.sentenceEn: A few potted plants added much life to the room.

增进.sentence: 经常通信能增进彼此的了解。

声誉.sentence: 这家百年老店一直珍惜自己的声誉。
声誉.sentenceEn: This century-old shop has always cherished its reputation.

处之泰然.meaning: 遇事沉着镇定，毫不慌乱。
处之泰然.sentence: 面对突发状况，他处之泰然，从容应对。
处之泰然.sentenceEn: Faced with the emergency, he stayed calm and handled it with ease.

处心积虑.sentence: 他处心积虑想要取代别人的位置。
处心积虑.sentenceEn: He schemed deliberately to take someone else's place.

多种多样.sentence: 学校的课外活动多种多样，深受学生喜爱。
多种多样.sentenceEn: The school's extracurricular activities are varied and well loved.

大同小异.meaning: 大部分相同，只有小部分不同。
大同小异.sentence: 两篇作文的内容大同小异，缺乏新意。
大同小异.sentenceEn: The two essays are largely the same and lack originality.

大量.sentence: 这项工程需要投入大量的人力和物力。
大量.sentenceEn: This project requires a great deal of manpower and resources.

天伦之乐.meaning: 家庭中亲人团聚的乐趣。
天伦之乐.sentence: 一家人围坐在一起，尽享天伦之乐。
天伦之乐.sentenceEn: The whole family sat together, enjoying domestic bliss.

失望.sentence: 这次考试没考好，他感到十分失望。
失望.sentenceEn: Having done poorly in the exam, he felt very disappointed.

失败.sentence: 失败是成功之母，不必为此灰心。
失败.sentenceEn: Failure is the mother of success; don't be disheartened.

奉行.sentence: 他始终奉行诚实守信的处世原则。
奉行.sentenceEn: He has always followed the principle of honesty and trust.

奋斗.sentence: 为了实现梦想，他不懈奋斗了多年。
奋斗.sentenceEn: To realize his dream, he struggled unremittingly for years.

妥协.meaning: 用让步的方式避免冲突或争执。
妥协.sentence: 在原则问题上，他从不轻易妥协。
妥协.sentenceEn: On matters of principle, he never compromised lightly.

妨碍.sentence: 在公共场所大声喧哗会妨碍他人。
妨碍.sentenceEn: Making noise in public places hinders others.

始终.en: all along; from start to finish
始终.sentence: 无论遇到多大困难，他始终没有放弃自己的梦想。
始终.sentenceEn: No matter how great the difficulties, he never once gave up his dream.

始终如一.sentence: 他对待朋友始终如一，从不因境遇改变。
始终如一.sentenceEn: He treats friends consistently, never changing with circumstances.

威严.meaning: 威武而又庄严；使人敬畏的气势。
威严.sentence: 校长说话时神情威严，让学生肃然起敬。
威严.sentenceEn: The principal looked dignified as he spoke, commanding the students' respect.

威胁.sentence: 环境污染严重威胁着人类的健康。

威风.sentence: 将军骑在高头大马上，显得格外威风。
威风.sentenceEn: Mounted on a tall horse, the general looked especially imposing.

婉转.meaning: 说话温和曲折，不直接；声音抑扬动听。
婉转.sentence: 为了不伤害对方，他婉转地拒绝了请求。
婉转.sentenceEn: So as not to hurt the other person, he tactfully declined the request.

存心.sentence: 他不是存心刁难你，只是要求比较严格。
存心.sentenceEn: He isn't deliberately making things hard for you; he's just strict.

孤独.sentence: 独自在异乡求学，他常常感到孤独。
孤独.sentenceEn: Studying alone in a strange land, he often felt lonely.

学习.meaning: 从阅读、听讲、研究中获得知识。
学习.sentence: 他学习十分刻苦，成绩一直名列前茅。
学习.sentenceEn: He studies very hard and consistently ranks near the top.

宁可.meaning: 表示比较利害后宁愿选取的一面。
宁可.sentence: 他宁可自己吃亏，也不愿让朋友为难。
宁可.sentenceEn: He would rather lose out himself than put his friend in a difficult spot.

安于现状.meaning: 满足于目前的状况，不求进取。
安于现状.en: be content with the status quo
安于现状.sentence: 他不愿安于现状，决心闯出一番事业。
安于现状.sentenceEn: Unwilling to settle for the status quo, he resolved to make his mark.

安慰.meaning: 用言语或行动使人心情安适。
安慰.sentence: 朋友失落的时候，她总是耐心地安慰对方。
安慰.sentenceEn: When her friends are down, she always patiently comforts them.

安排.meaning: 有条理地处理，分先后地处置。
安排.sentence: 老师合理安排了这学期的复习计划。
安排.sentenceEn: The teacher arranged this term's revision plan sensibly.

安静.sentence: 图书馆里十分安静，连翻书声都听得见。
安静.sentenceEn: The library was so quiet you could hear pages turning.

完善.sentence: 这套制度还不够完善，需要进一步修改。
完善.sentenceEn: This system isn't yet perfect and needs further revision.

定位.meaning: 确定位置或性质；准确认定。
定位.sentence: 他给自己的人生做了清晰的定位，目标明确。
定位.sentenceEn: He gave his life a clear orientation, with a definite goal.

实力.meaning: 实在的力量（军事、经济、能力等）。
实力.sentence: 凭借雄厚的实力，这支球队夺得了冠军。
实力.sentenceEn: With its formidable strength, the team won the title.

实践.meaning: 实行主张；改造客观世界的活动。
实践.sentence: 只有把知识运用到实践中，才能真正掌握。
实践.sentenceEn: Only by applying knowledge in practice can one truly master it.

审查.meaning: 检查核对是否正确、合法。
审查.sentence: 这份文件经过严格审查后才得以发布。
审查.sentenceEn: The document was released only after strict review.

宽厚.sentence: 他为人宽厚，从不计较别人的过失。
宽厚.sentenceEn: He is generous by nature and never holds others' faults against them.

宽容.meaning: 宽大有气量，不计较、不苛求。
宽容.sentence: 他为人宽容，从不与人斤斤计较。
宽容.sentenceEn: He is tolerant by nature and never fusses over trifles.

宽慰.sentence: 听到孩子平安的消息，她才感到宽慰。
宽慰.sentenceEn: Only on hearing the child was safe did she feel relieved.

寻找.sentence: 他在人群中焦急地寻找着自己的孩子。
寻找.sentenceEn: He searched anxiously for his child in the crowd.

寻求.sentence: 遇到难题时，他主动向老师寻求帮助。
寻求.sentenceEn: When stuck, he took the initiative to seek the teacher's help.

导致.meaning: 引起，造成（多指不好的结果）。
导致.sentence: 长期熬夜导致他的身体每况愈下。
导致.sentenceEn: Staying up late for a long time caused his health to deteriorate.

尊敬.sentence: 他德高望重，深受大家的尊敬。
尊敬.sentenceEn: Of great virtue and prestige, he is deeply respected by all.

尝试.sentence: 面对新事物，他总是勇于尝试。
尝试.sentenceEn: Faced with new things, he is always ready to give them a try.

就算.sentence: 就算前方困难重重，他也决心坚持到底。
就算.sentenceEn: Even if there are countless difficulties ahead, he is determined to see it through.

尽如人意.meaning: 事情完全符合人的心意（多用于否定）。
尽如人意.sentence: 事情的结果未必尽如人意，要学会接受。
尽如人意.sentenceEn: Outcomes aren't always entirely satisfactory; one must learn to accept them.

尽管.meaning: 表示姑且承认某种事实，下文常用“还是、仍然”转折。
尽管.en: Even though; despite the fact that.
尽管.sentence: 尽管天气恶劣，救援人员仍然坚持搜救。
尽管.sentenceEn: Despite the harsh weather, the rescuers persisted in the search.

局限.sentence: 他的眼光不局限于眼前，而是放眼未来。
局限.sentenceEn: His vision was not confined to the present but looked to the future.

居然.sentence: 平时不用功的他，这次居然考了第一名。
居然.sentenceEn: He, who usually doesn't study hard, surprisingly came first this time.

展现.sentence: 在舞台上，他充分展现了自己的才华。
展现.sentenceEn: On stage, he fully displayed his talent.

展示.meaning: 清楚地摆出来，明显地表现出来。
展示.sentence: 在画展上，他向观众展示了自己的最新作品。
展示.sentenceEn: At the exhibition he showed the audience his latest works.

展翅高飞.meaning: 张开翅膀高高飞起，比喻奋发有为。
展翅高飞.sentence: 毕业后，他立志展翅高飞，闯出一番事业。
展翅高飞.sentenceEn: After graduating, he resolved to spread his wings and make his mark.

屡见不鲜.sentence: 这样的现象如今屡见不鲜，不足为奇。
屡见不鲜.sentenceEn: Such phenomena are common nowadays and hardly surprising.

差异.sentence: 两种文化之间存在着明显的差异。
差异.sentenceEn: There are clear differences between the two cultures.

差距.sentence: 我和优秀同学之间还有不小的差距。
差距.sentenceEn: There's still quite a gap between me and the top students.

干扰.sentence: 嘈杂的声音严重干扰了他的思路。
干扰.sentenceEn: The noise seriously disrupted his train of thought.

干燥.sentence: 北方的冬天气候十分干燥。
干燥.sentenceEn: Winters in the north are very dry.

平凡.sentence: 他虽然只是一名平凡的工人，却深受大家的尊敬。
平凡.sentenceEn: Though only an ordinary worker, he is deeply respected by everyone.

平淡无奇.meaning: 平平常常，没有什么特点。
平淡无奇.sentence: 这个故事看似平淡无奇，却饱含深意。
平淡无奇.sentenceEn: The story seems ordinary but is full of meaning.

广博.sentence: 这位学者知识广博，令人敬佩。
广博.sentenceEn: This scholar's knowledge is broad and admirable.

广泛.sentence: 他兴趣广泛，琴棋书画样样都会。
广泛.sentenceEn: His interests are wide-ranging, from music to chess to painting.

废除.sentence: 这项不合理的规定早就应该废除。
废除.sentenceEn: This unreasonable rule should have been abolished long ago.

建立.sentence: 经过努力，两国建立了友好的合作关系。
建立.sentenceEn: After much effort, the two nations established friendly cooperation.

开展.meaning: 活动等从小到大地发展、进行。
开展.sentence: 学校开展了形式多样的课外活动。
开展.sentenceEn: The school carried out a variety of extracurricular activities.

弊端.sentence: 这种制度的弊端已经逐渐显露出来。
弊端.sentenceEn: The drawbacks of this system have gradually come to light.

引发.sentence: 这则新闻引发了社会的广泛讨论。
引发.sentenceEn: The news triggered widespread public discussion.

引导.sentence: 老师循循善诱，引导学生独立思考。
引导.sentenceEn: The teacher patiently guided the students to think independently.

引起.sentence: 他的发言引起了在场所有人的共鸣。
引起.sentenceEn: His remarks struck a chord with everyone present.

强化.meaning: 加强，使变得更强、更牢固。
强化.sentence: 通过反复练习，可以强化我们的记忆。
强化.sentenceEn: Through repeated practice, we can reinforce our memory.

形影不离.meaning: 像形体和影子那样分不开，形容关系密切。
形影不离.sentence: 这对好朋友形影不离，总是一起上下学。
形影不离.sentenceEn: The two friends are inseparable, always going to school together.

形成.meaning: 通过发展变化而成为某种事物或状态。
形成.sentence: 经过多年积累，他形成了自己独特的风格。
形成.sentenceEn: After years of accumulation, he formed his own distinctive style.

影响.sentence: 父母的言行会深深影响孩子的成长。
影响.sentenceEn: Parents' words and deeds deeply influence a child's growth.

徒然.sentence: 没有计划地忙碌，往往只是徒然浪费时间。
徒然.sentenceEn: Busying oneself without a plan often just wastes time in vain.

得意忘形.sentence: 取得一点成绩就得意忘形，是不可取的。
得意忘形.sentenceEn: Getting carried away over a small success is unwise.

徘徊.meaning: 在一个地方来回地走；犹豫不决。
徘徊.sentence: 他在路口徘徊了很久，迟迟不肯离去。
徘徊.sentenceEn: He lingered at the crossroads for a long time, reluctant to leave.

心安理得.meaning: 自信做事合理，心里坦然。
心安理得.sentence: 凭自己的劳动获得报酬，他拿得心安理得。
心安理得.sentenceEn: Earning pay by his own labour, he took it with a clear conscience.

心意.meaning: 对人的情意；心里的想法。
心意.sentence: 这份礼物虽小，却代表了他的一片心意。
心意.sentenceEn: Though small, the gift expressed his heartfelt regard.

心旷神怡.sentence: 站在山顶远眺，他顿时感到心旷神怡。
心旷神怡.sentenceEn: Gazing out from the summit, he felt instantly relaxed and joyful.

心灰意冷.sentence: 接连的打击让他心灰意冷，提不起精神。
心灰意冷.sentenceEn: Repeated blows left him disheartened and listless.

心胸.sentence: 他心胸开阔，从不为一点小事而烦恼。
心胸.sentenceEn: He is broad-minded and never frets over trifles.

必然.sentence: 不付出努力，必然难以取得好成绩。
必然.sentenceEn: Without effort, good results are inevitably hard to achieve.

忏悔.meaning: 认识到错误而感到痛心、悔恨。
忏悔.sentence: 他对自己当年的过错深感忏悔。
忏悔.sentenceEn: He deeply repented the mistakes of his earlier years.

忐忑.sentence: 等待面试结果时，他的心里十分忐忑。
忐忑.sentenceEn: Waiting for the interview result, he felt very uneasy.

忐忑不安.sentence: 等待成绩公布时，他忐忑不安，坐立难安。
忐忑不安.sentenceEn: Waiting for the results, he was anxious and couldn't sit still.

志同道合.sentence: 他们志同道合，决定一起创业。
志同道合.sentenceEn: Being like-minded, they decided to start a business together.

忘年之交.meaning: 年岁相差大却交情深厚的朋友。
忘年之交.sentence: 他和这位老教授成了忘年之交，无话不谈。
忘年之交.sentenceEn: He and the old professor became close friends despite the age gap.

忙碌.sentence: 临近期末，老师和同学都十分忙碌。
忙碌.sentenceEn: As the term's end neared, teachers and students were all busy.

忧虑.sentence: 他对孩子的前途深感忧虑，整夜难眠。
忧虑.sentenceEn: He was deeply worried about his child's future and couldn't sleep.

忽略.sentence: 他只顾埋头工作，忽略了家人的感受。
忽略.sentenceEn: Buried in his work, he overlooked his family's feelings.

怀抱.sentence: 母亲把婴儿紧紧搂在怀抱里。
怀抱.sentenceEn: The mother held the baby tightly in her arms.

怀疑.sentence: 大家都怀疑这件事另有隐情。
怀疑.sentenceEn: Everyone suspected there was more to the matter.

态度.meaning: 对事情的看法和采取的行动方式。
态度.sentence: 面对批评，他态度诚恳，虚心接受。
态度.sentenceEn: Faced with criticism, his attitude was sincere and he accepted it humbly.

思想.sentence: 这篇文章思想深刻，读来令人回味无穷。
思想.sentenceEn: This essay is profound in thought and leaves one pondering.

思考.meaning: 进行分析、判断等思维活动。
思考.sentence: 遇到问题时，他总会冷静地思考。
思考.sentenceEn: When problems arise, he always thinks them over calmly.

急促.sentence: 听到敲门声，他急促地跑去开门。
急促.sentenceEn: Hearing the knock, he hurried to open the door.

急功近利.meaning: 急于求成，贪图眼前利益。
急功近利.sentence: 做学问不能急功近利，要踏实积累。
急功近利.sentenceEn: In study one mustn't be eager for quick gains; steady accumulation is key.

怨天尤人.meaning: 抱怨上天，责怪别人；指遇挫只会埋怨。
怨天尤人.sentence: 遇到失败，与其怨天尤人，不如反省自己。
怨天尤人.sentenceEn: On failing, rather than blaming the world, it's better to reflect on oneself.

恼怒.sentence: 听到这种无理的指责，他十分恼怒。
恼怒.sentenceEn: Hearing such unreasonable accusations, he was furious.

悠久.sentence: 中国有着悠久的历史和灿烂的文化。
悠久.sentenceEn: China has a long history and a splendid culture.

悠然.sentence: 退休后，他过着悠然自得的生活。
悠然.sentenceEn: After retiring, he led a leisurely, contented life.

悲惨.meaning: 处境或遭遇极其痛苦，令人伤心。
悲惨.sentence: 这部小说讲述了主人公悲惨的一生。
悲惨.sentenceEn: The novel tells of the protagonist's tragic life.

情不自禁.sentence: 看到久别的母亲，她情不自禁地流下眼泪。
情不自禁.sentenceEn: Seeing her long-absent mother, she couldn't help shedding tears.

情况.sentence: 他向老师说明了事情的具体情况。
情况.sentenceEn: He explained the specific circumstances to the teacher.

情有独钟.meaning: 对某人或某物特别有感情、偏爱。
情有独钟.sentence: 他对古典音乐情有独钟，百听不厌。
情有独钟.sentenceEn: He has a special love for classical music and never tires of it.

情绪.meaning: 由感觉、情感产生的心理状态。
情绪.sentence: 考试失利后，他情绪低落，闷闷不乐。
情绪.sentenceEn: After failing the exam, his mood sank and he was glum.

惆怅.sentence: 望着渐渐远去的列车，他心中充满惆怅。
惆怅.sentenceEn: Watching the train recede, his heart filled with melancholy.

惊叹.sentence: 大自然的鬼斧神工令人惊叹。

惊慌失措.meaning: 害怕慌张，不知如何是好。
惊慌失措.sentence: 听到火警，人群一时惊慌失措，四处奔逃。
惊慌失措.sentenceEn: Hearing the fire alarm, the crowd panicked and fled in all directions.

惦念.sentence: 离家在外，他时常惦念年迈的父母。
惦念.sentenceEn: Away from home, he often thought of his aged parents.

惬意.sentence: 午后晒着太阳喝茶，感觉十分惬意。
惬意.sentenceEn: Sipping tea in the afternoon sun feels wonderfully pleasant.

惭愧.meaning: 因缺点或过失感到不安。
惭愧.sentence: 没能帮上忙，他感到十分惭愧。
惭愧.sentenceEn: Unable to help, he felt deeply ashamed.

意见.sentence: 对于这个方案，大家提出了不同的意见。
意见.sentenceEn: People raised differing opinions on the proposal.

意识.meaning: 觉察；头脑对客观世界的反映。
意识.sentence: 直到出了事，他才意识到问题的严重。
意识.sentenceEn: Only when trouble struck did he realize how serious it was.

感化.meaning: 用言行影响教育，使人转变。
感化.sentence: 老师用爱心感化了这个顽皮的学生。
感化.sentenceEn: The teacher won over the naughty student with kindness.

感受.meaning: 接触外界事物得到的影响、体会。
感受.sentence: 站在山顶，他深深感受到大自然的壮丽。
感受.sentenceEn: Standing on the summit, he deeply felt the grandeur of nature.

感叹.sentence: 望着夕阳，他不禁感叹时光的流逝。
感叹.sentenceEn: Gazing at the sunset, he sighed at the passage of time.

感应.meaning: 受外界影响而引起相应的反应。
感应.sentence: 这盏灯能感应到人的走近而自动亮起。
感应.sentenceEn: This lamp senses people approaching and lights up automatically.

感慨.sentence: 重回母校，他心中感慨万千。
感慨.sentenceEn: Returning to his old school, he was filled with emotion.

感触.meaning: 接触外界事物引起的思想情绪。
感触.sentence: 重游故地，他心中生出许多感触。
感触.sentenceEn: Revisiting old haunts stirred many feelings in him.

慈爱.meaning: 年长者对年幼者慈祥怜爱。
慈爱.sentence: 奶奶用慈爱的目光看着孙儿。
慈爱.sentenceEn: Grandma looked at her grandchild with loving eyes.

慌忙.sentence: 听到上课铃响，他慌忙跑进教室。
慌忙.sentenceEn: At the bell, he hurried flusteredly into the classroom.

慎重.sentence: 这是关系重大的决定，必须慎重对待。
慎重.sentenceEn: This is a major decision and must be treated with care.

憧憬.meaning: 向往，对未来的美好期待。
憧憬.sentence: 他对未来的大学生活充满了憧憬。
憧憬.sentenceEn: He was full of yearning for his future university life.

懊悔.meaning: 做错事或说错话后，心里自恨不该如此。
懊悔.sentence: 他懊悔当初没有听从父母的劝告。
懊悔.sentenceEn: He regretted not having listened to his parents' advice.

成全.sentence: 为了成全朋友的梦想，他甘愿退出。
成全.sentenceEn: To help his friend's dream come true, he willingly stepped aside.

成就.sentence: 他在科研上取得了巨大的成就。
成就.sentenceEn: He achieved a great deal in scientific research.

我行我素.meaning: 不管别人怎么说，仍按自己的方式行事。
我行我素.sentence: 他不顾大家的劝告，依然我行我素。
我行我素.sentenceEn: Ignoring everyone's advice, he still did things his own way.

或者.sentence: 你可以选择留下，或者跟我们一起出发。
或者.sentenceEn: You may choose to stay, or set off with us.

或许.sentence: 他今天没来，或许是生病了。
或许.sentenceEn: He didn't come today; perhaps he is ill.

战胜.meaning: 在斗争或竞赛中取得胜利。
战胜.sentence: 凭着顽强的毅力，他战胜了病魔。
战胜.sentenceEn: With tenacious will, he overcame his illness.

截然不同.meaning: 形容两种事物毫无共同之处。
截然不同.sentence: 兄弟俩性格截然不同，一个外向，一个内向。
截然不同.sentenceEn: The two brothers have completely different personalities — one outgoing, one introverted.

手段.meaning: 为达到目的而采取的方法。
手段.sentence: 为了达到目的，他不择手段。
手段.sentenceEn: To achieve his ends, he stopped at no means.

手足之情.sentence: 兄弟俩虽偶有争执，手足之情却从未改变。
手足之情.sentenceEn: Though the brothers sometimes quarrel, their bond never changes.

手足无措.meaning: 形容举动慌乱，不知怎么办。
手足无措.en: at a loss what to do
手足无措.sentence: 面对老师突然的提问，他一时手足无措。
手足无措.sentenceEn: Faced with the teacher's sudden question, he was momentarily at a loss.

打击.sentence: 接连的失败给了他沉重的打击。
打击.sentenceEn: Repeated failures dealt him a heavy blow.

打滚.sentence: 小狗在草地上欢快地打滚。
打滚.sentenceEn: The puppy rolled about happily on the grass.

打量.sentence: 他上下打量着这位陌生的来客。
打量.sentenceEn: He looked the stranger up and down.

扩大.meaning: 使范围、规模等比原来大。
扩大.sentence: 公司决定扩大生产规模。
扩大.sentenceEn: The company decided to expand its production scale.

批评.meaning: 指出缺点错误；对错误进行分析。
批评.sentence: 因为没完成作业，他受到了老师的批评。
批评.sentenceEn: For not finishing his homework, he was criticized by the teacher.

承受.sentence: 面对巨大的压力，他默默承受，从不向人诉苦。
承受.sentenceEn: Under enormous pressure, he bore it silently and never complained.

承认.sentence: 做错了事，他勇于承认并改正。
承认.sentenceEn: Having erred, he bravely admitted it and made amends.

技巧.sentence: 经过苦练，他掌握了高超的绘画技巧。
技巧.sentenceEn: Through hard practice, he mastered superb painting techniques.

把握.meaning: 抓住（机会等）；成功的可靠性。
把握.sentence: 机会难得，他决心牢牢把握，不轻易放过。
把握.sentenceEn: The chance was rare, so he resolved to seize it firmly.

抑制.meaning: 压下去；控制（感情、活动等）。
抑制.sentence: 他努力抑制住内心的激动，保持镇定。
抑制.sentenceEn: He tried hard to restrain his excitement and stay composed.

抒发.sentence: 他用诗歌抒发了对家乡的思念。
抒发.sentenceEn: He expressed his longing for home through poetry.

抒情.sentence: 这首诗借景抒情，情真意切。
抒情.sentenceEn: The poem expresses feeling through scenery, sincere and heartfelt.

投入.meaning: 放进去；也指专心、全心地参与。
投入.en: To put in; to throw oneself into; engrossed.
投入.sentence: 他全身心投入到这次科学比赛中。
投入.sentenceEn: He threw himself wholeheartedly into the science competition.

投诉.meaning: 向有关部门提出申诉（多指消费者）。
投诉.en: To complain; to lodge a complaint.
投诉.sentence: 顾客就食物的卫生问题向商家投诉。
投诉.sentenceEn: The customer complained to the merchant about the food's hygiene.

抖擞.sentence: 他抖擞精神，准备迎接新的挑战。
抖擞.sentenceEn: He braced himself, ready to meet the new challenge.

抛弃.sentence: 无论多么困难，他都没有抛弃自己的信念。
抛弃.sentenceEn: No matter how hard things got, he never abandoned his beliefs.

抱怨.meaning: 心中不满，数说别人不对。
抱怨.sentence: 遇到困难时，他从不抱怨，只想办法解决。
抱怨.sentenceEn: When difficulties arose, he never complained, only sought solutions.

抵抗.meaning: 用力量制止对方的进攻。
抵抗.sentence: 军民团结一心，奋力抵抗外敌。
抵抗.sentenceEn: Soldiers and civilians united to resist the foreign foe.

抵达.sentence: 经过长途跋涉，他们终于抵达了目的地。
抵达.sentenceEn: After a long trek, they finally reached their destination.

拒绝.sentence: 面对诱惑，他坚决地拒绝了。
拒绝.sentenceEn: Faced with temptation, he firmly refused.

拘束.meaning: 过分约束；不自然、不自在。
拘束.sentence: 第一次到陌生人家里，他显得有些拘束。
拘束.sentenceEn: Visiting a stranger's home for the first time, he seemed a little ill at ease.

持之以恒.sentence: 学习贵在持之以恒，不能半途而废。
持之以恒.sentenceEn: In study, perseverance matters most; one mustn't give up halfway.

指引.sentence: 在路人的指引下，他找到了车站。
指引.sentenceEn: With a passer-by's directions, he found the station.

按照.sentence: 请大家按照规定的顺序排队。
按照.sentenceEn: Please queue according to the prescribed order.

挑战.meaning: 激使对方应战；比喻面对困难。
挑战.sentence: 面对新的挑战，他没有丝毫退缩。
挑战.sentenceEn: Facing the new challenge, he didn't flinch in the least.

挣扎.sentence: 落水的人在水中拼命挣扎。
挣扎.sentenceEn: The drowning man struggled desperately in the water.

振奋.sentence: 这个好消息令全队上下十分振奋。
振奋.sentenceEn: The good news greatly heartened the whole team.

挺身而出.meaning: 勇敢地站出来承担责任或面对危险。
挺身而出.sentence: 看到有人落水，他毫不犹豫地挺身而出。
挺身而出.sentenceEn: Seeing someone fall into the water, he stepped forward without hesitation.

捕捞.sentence: 渔民出海捕捞，满载而归。
捕捞.sentenceEn: The fishermen went out to fish and came back with a full load.

掌握.sentence: 经过反复练习，他终于掌握了这项技能。
掌握.sentenceEn: After repeated practice, he finally mastered the skill.

排练.sentence: 为了演出成功，同学们反复排练，毫不松懈。
排练.sentenceEn: For a successful performance, the students rehearsed repeatedly without slacking.

排解.sentence: 朋友的陪伴帮他排解了心中的烦闷。
排解.sentenceEn: His friends' company helped relieve the gloom in his heart.

排除.sentence: 技术人员很快排除了机器的故障。
排除.sentenceEn: The technicians quickly cleared the machine's fault.

探索.meaning: 多方寻求答案，研究解决问题。
探索.sentence: 科学家不断探索宇宙的奥秘，从未停下脚步。
探索.sentenceEn: Scientists keep exploring the mysteries of the universe and never stop.

探视.sentence: 他抽空到医院探视生病的同事。
探视.sentenceEn: He found time to visit his sick colleague in hospital.

探讨.sentence: 师生一起深入探讨了这个问题。
探讨.sentenceEn: Teacher and students explored the question in depth together.

接受.sentence: 听了大家的劝告，他终于接受了这个建议。
接受.sentenceEn: After hearing everyone's advice, he finally accepted the suggestion.

接触.sentence: 通过这份工作，他接触到了各行各业的人。
接触.sentenceEn: Through this job, he came into contact with people of all trades.

控制.meaning: 掌握住对象，使不超出范围或不任意活动。
控制.en: To control; to keep in check.
控制.sentence: 他努力控制自己的情绪，不让自己发脾气。
控制.sentenceEn: He tried hard to control his emotions and not lose his temper.

控诉.meaning: 向有关机关或公众陈述受害事实。
控诉.sentence: 受害者向法庭控诉了歹徒的罪行。
控诉.sentenceEn: The victim denounced the criminal's deeds to the court.

推动.sentence: 科技的进步推动了社会的发展。
推动.sentenceEn: Advances in technology have driven society forward.

推崇.sentence: 他学识渊博，深受同行推崇。
推崇.sentenceEn: His learning was profound, and peers held him in high esteem.

推敲.sentence: 这篇文章的用词经过了反复推敲。
推敲.sentenceEn: The wording of this essay was carefully weighed again and again.

推行.sentence: 学校开始推行新的作息制度。
推行.sentenceEn: The school began carrying out a new schedule.

推进.sentence: 这项工程正在稳步推进。

掩盖.sentence: 他试图掩盖事情的真相，却被识破了。
掩盖.sentenceEn: He tried to conceal the truth but was seen through.

措施.meaning: 针对情况采取的处理办法。
措施.sentence: 政府采取了有力的措施来防治污染。
措施.sentenceEn: The government took strong measures to curb pollution.

描绘.sentence: 这篇文章生动地描绘了乡村的美景。
描绘.sentenceEn: The essay vividly portrayed the beauty of the countryside.

提升.en: To raise; to enhance; to elevate.
提升.sentence: 多阅读能有效提升我们的写作能力。
提升.sentenceEn: Reading more can effectively raise our writing ability.

提示.meaning: 把对方没想到的提出来，引起注意。
提示.sentence: 在老师的提示下，他很快找到了答案。
提示.sentenceEn: With the teacher's hint, he quickly found the answer.

提醒.sentence: 多亏朋友及时提醒，他才没有迟到。
提醒.sentenceEn: Thanks to his friend's timely reminder, he wasn't late.

揣摩.sentence: 他细心揣摩老师的意图。
揣摩.sentenceEn: He carefully tried to figure out the teacher's intention.

撤离.sentence: 接到命令后，士兵迅速撤离了阵地。
撤离.sentenceEn: On orders, the soldiers quickly withdrew from the position.

擅长.sentence: 他擅长绘画，作品多次在比赛中获奖。
擅长.sentenceEn: He is good at painting, and his works have won prizes many times.

操作.sentence: 他熟练地操作着这台机器。

支持.sentence: 他的想法得到了大家的支持。

支援.sentence: 各地纷纷捐款捐物，支援灾区。
支援.sentenceEn: People everywhere donated to aid the disaster area.

收获.meaning: 取得的成果；收割农作物。
收获.sentence: 这次旅行让他收获颇丰，增长了不少见识。
收获.sentenceEn: The trip was very rewarding for him and broadened his knowledge.

收藏.sentence: 他喜欢收藏各种各样的邮票。
收藏.sentenceEn: He likes collecting all kinds of stamps.

改善.sentence: 近年来，村民的生活得到了很大改善。
改善.sentenceEn: In recent years, villagers' lives have greatly improved.

改正.sentence: 发现错误后，他立刻加以改正。
改正.sentenceEn: On finding the error, he corrected it at once.

改良.sentence: 农民通过改良土壤提高了产量。

经历.meaning: 亲身见过、做过；也指亲身经过的事情。

哑口无言.sentenceEn: Faced with ironclad evidence, he was instantly struck dumb, unable to argue further.

判决.meaning: 法院对案件做出的裁定。
判决.sentence: 经过几个月的审理，法院终于对这起案件做出了判决。

泄.meaning: 排出（液体、气体）；泄露；发泄。

泄.sentenceEn: On a sudden impulse, he vented all his anger on his innocent younger brother.

葡萄.meaning: 一种甜而多汁的水果，可生吃或酿酒。

象征.meaning: 用具体事物表示某种特殊意义；这种事物。
象征.sentence: 鸽子在世界各地都象征着和平与安宁。
象征.sentenceEn: The dove symbolizes peace and tranquillity all over the world.

风俗.meaning: 社会上长期形成的风尚、礼节、习惯等。

辞旧迎新.meaning: 辞别旧的一年，迎接新的一年。
辞旧迎新.en: ring out the old year and ring in the new

燃放.meaning: 点燃（鞭炮、烟花等）使爆发。
燃放.sentence: 过年时，人们喜欢燃放烟花来增添节日的气氛。

瓶瓶罐罐.meaning: 泛指各种瓶子罐子等容器。
瓶瓶罐罐.en: jars and bottles; odds and ends

瓶瓶罐罐.sentenceEn: The kitchen shelves were crammed with all sorts of jars and bottles holding oil, salt, and sauces.

厄运.sentence: 面对接二连三的厄运，她始终没有放弃对生活的希望。
厄运.sentenceEn: Faced with one misfortune after another, she never gave up hope in life.

前夕.meaning: 节日或重大事件的前一天或前一段时间。

前夕.sentenceEn: On the eve of the exam, he was still burning the midnight oil, revising his lessons.

碗碟.sentence: 吃完饭后，她主动把桌上的碗碟收拾干净。
碗碟.sentenceEn: After the meal, she took the initiative to clear away the bowls and dishes.

预示.meaning: 预先显示（将要发生的事）。
预示.sentence: 天边那片乌云，似乎预示着一场暴风雨即将来临。
预示.sentenceEn: The dark cloud on the horizon seemed to foreshadow an approaching storm.

兆头.sentence: 老人们认为，喜鹊登门是个好兆头，预示着喜事临门。
兆头.sentenceEn: The old folk believe a magpie at the door is a good omen, foretelling happy news.

恭敬.sentence: 他恭敬地向老师鞠了一躬，感谢老师多年的教导。
恭敬.sentenceEn: He bowed respectfully to his teacher, thanking him for years of guidance.

万事大吉.meaning: 一切事情都很圆满顺利。
万事大吉.sentence: 他以为考完试就万事大吉，可以尽情地玩了。
万事大吉.sentenceEn: He thought that once the exams were over, all would be well and he could play to his heart's content.

元旦.meaning: 公历每年的第一天，一月一日。

元旦.sentenceEn: On New Year's Day, the school held a lively celebration.

贼.sentence: 那个贼趁人不注意，偷偷把钱包拿走了。
贼.sentenceEn: The thief, taking advantage of a careless moment, quietly made off with the wallet.

鱼尾纹.meaning: 眼角的皱纹，因形似鱼尾而得名。

鱼尾纹.sentenceEn: Time spares no one; a few crow's feet had quietly appeared at the corners of her eyes.

装饰.meaning: 在物体表面加些附属的东西使美观；装饰品。

圣诞.meaning: 圣诞节，纪念耶稣诞生的节日。

结婚.sentence: 经过多年的相恋，这对情侣终于决定结婚了。
结婚.sentenceEn: After years of love, the couple finally decided to get married.

嫁.sentence: 姐姐就要嫁到外地去了，妈妈又高兴又舍不得。
嫁.sentenceEn: My elder sister is about to marry and move away; Mum is both happy and reluctant to part.

视讯.meaning: 通过网络传送的影像和声音；视频通讯。

视讯.sentenceEn: Living far apart, they could only greet each other through video calls.

沉默寡言.sentence: 他平时沉默寡言，可一谈起篮球就滔滔不绝。

副.meaning: 居第二位的；用于成套或成对的东西的量词。
副.sentence: 他戴上一副厚厚的眼镜，认真地看起书来。

酷.meaning: 残暴；程度深；形容时髦、帅气。
酷.sentence: 夏日的午后，酷热的阳光几乎要把柏油马路晒化了。
酷.sentenceEn: On a summer afternoon, the scorching sun nearly melted the asphalt road.

承诺.meaning: 答应别人的事；答应做某事。

歉意.sentence: 他为自己的失误向大家表达了深深的歉意。

围炉.sentence: 除夕夜，一家人围炉而坐，吃着热腾腾的团圆饭。

蒸腾.sentence: 清晨，湖面上热气蒸腾，宛如仙境一般。

叽叽喳喳.meaning: 形容鸟叫声或细碎的说话声。

缺席.meaning: 该到而没有到（会议、活动等）。

缺席.sentenceEn: Because of illness, he had to be absent from this important meeting.

悦耳.sentence: 悦耳的歌声从远处传来，让人忍不住停下脚步。

红枣.meaning: 红色的枣子，可食用、入药。

儿媳妇.sentence: 婆婆和儿媳妇相处得十分融洽，亲如母女。

魅力.sentence: 他的演讲充满魅力，深深吸引了在场的每一个人。

博物馆.meaning: 收藏、展览文物或标本的场所。

遗产.meaning: 前人留下的财富或文化；死者留下的财产。

巴刹.sentence: 妈妈一大早就去巴刹买了新鲜的鱼和蔬菜。

同胞.meaning: 同一父母所生的；同一国家或民族的人。

时尚.meaning: 当时社会上流行的风尚。

彩绘.meaning: 器物或建筑上的彩色图画；用彩色描绘。

娱乐.meaning: 使人快乐；快乐有趣的活动。

娘惹.meaning: （新马一带）土生华人女性，也指其文化。

拍摄.meaning: 用照相机或摄影机摄取（影像）。

平均.meaning: 把总数按份儿均匀计算；没有轻重多少之分。

闪耀.meaning: 光亮强烈地照射或闪动。

横梁.sentence: 工人们小心地把粗大的横梁架到了两根柱子上。

循环.meaning: 事物周而复始地运动或变化。

山谷.meaning: 两山之间狭长低洼的地方。

株.meaning: 露在地面上的树木的根和茎；植物的量词。

属于.meaning: 归某一方面或为某人所有。

戏剧.meaning: 通过演员表演故事来反映生活的艺术。

溺爱.en: to spoil; to dote on excessively
溺爱.sentence: 父母一味溺爱孩子，反而害了他的将来。
溺爱.sentenceEn: Parents who blindly spoil their child end up harming his future instead.

颈项.meaning: 脖子，头和躯干相连的部分。
颈项.sentence: 长时间低头看手机，他的颈项变得又酸又痛。
颈项.sentenceEn: From looking down at his phone for a long time, his neck became sore and painful.

鬓.meaning: 脸旁靠近耳朵两侧的头发。
鬓.en: the hair at the temples; sideburns
鬓.sentence: 岁月不饶人，他两鬓已经添了不少白发。
鬓.sentenceEn: Time spares no one; quite a few grey hairs have appeared at his temples.

桃.meaning: 桃树的果实，多汁味甜；也指桃树。
桃.sentence: 夏天一到，市场上的桃又甜又多汁。
桃.sentenceEn: As soon as summer arrives, the peaches at the market are sweet and juicy.

瓣.meaning: 花瓣；也指果实、球茎等分开的片状部分。
瓣.sentence: 她轻轻掰下一瓣橘子，放进嘴里慢慢品尝。
瓣.sentenceEn: She gently broke off a segment of the orange and slowly savoured it.

重逢.en: to meet again after a separation; to reunite
重逢.sentence: 阔别多年的老友终于重逢，两人激动得热泪盈眶。
重逢.sentenceEn: The old friends, parted for many years, finally reunited, both moved to tears.

稀罕.meaning: 稀少而难得；也指认为某物希奇而喜爱。
稀罕.en: rare; scarce; to treasure as rare
稀罕.sentence: 在沙漠里，一场雨水是再稀罕不过的恩赐。
稀罕.sentenceEn: In the desert, a single rainfall is the rarest of blessings.

三顾茅庐.meaning: 比喻真心诚意，一再邀请有才能的人。
三顾茅庐.en: to repeatedly and sincerely invite a talented person (from Liu Bei visiting Zhuge Liang thrice)
三顾茅庐.sentence: 为了请到这位专家，公司老板三顾茅庐，态度十分诚恳。
三顾茅庐.sentenceEn: To recruit this expert, the company boss called on him repeatedly and sincerely.

争霸.meaning: 争夺霸主地位，争当首领或最强者。
争霸.en: to contend for supremacy; to vie for hegemony
争霸.sentence: 战国时期，各国诸侯为了争霸而连年征战。
争霸.sentenceEn: During the Warring States period, the feudal lords waged years of war to contend for supremacy.

足智多谋.meaning: 智慧多，计谋多，形容人善于料事和应变。
足智多谋.sentence: 这位军师足智多谋，总能在危急关头想出妙计。
足智多谋.sentenceEn: This strategist is resourceful and full of clever schemes, always devising ingenious plans at critical moments.

起伏.meaning: 一起一落；高低不平，形容变化或情绪的波动。
起伏.en: to rise and fall; to undulate; to fluctuate
起伏.sentence: 远处的山峦连绵起伏，在云雾中若隐若现。
起伏.sentenceEn: The distant mountains undulate one after another, faintly visible amid the clouds and mist.

斥责.sentence: 因为撒谎，他被父亲严厉地斥责了一顿。
斥责.sentenceEn: For lying, he was sternly rebuked by his father.

严寒.sentence: 在北方的严寒中，河面早已结上了厚厚的冰。
严寒.sentenceEn: In the bitter cold of the north, the river surface had long frozen over with thick ice.

恳请.sentence: 他写信恳请校长再给自己一次改过的机会。
恳请.sentenceEn: He wrote a letter earnestly requesting that the principal give him another chance to make amends.

酿.meaning: 利用发酵制造酒、醋等；也比喻逐渐形成不好的结果。
酿.en: to brew; to ferment; to lead to (bad consequences)
酿.sentence: 奶奶用自家的糯米酿了一坛香甜的米酒。
酿.sentenceEn: Grandma used her own glutinous rice to brew a jar of sweet, fragrant rice wine.

涌.meaning: 水或人、事物等急速冒出、流出或聚集。
涌.en: to gush; to surge; to well up
涌.sentence: 听到这个好消息，一股暖流顿时从他心头涌出。
涌.sentenceEn: On hearing the good news, a warm current suddenly welled up from his heart.

繁殖.meaning: 生物产生新的个体，使种类数量增多。
繁殖.en: to reproduce; to breed; to propagate
繁殖.sentence: 在温暖潮湿的环境里，细菌繁殖得非常迅速。
繁殖.sentenceEn: In a warm and humid environment, bacteria reproduce very rapidly.

饲料.meaning: 喂养家禽、家畜等动物的食物。
饲料.sentence: 农场主每天清晨都给鸡舍添加新鲜的饲料。
饲料.sentenceEn: Every morning the farm owner adds fresh feed to the chicken coop.

佳肴.sentence: 餐桌上摆满了色香味俱全的美味佳肴。
佳肴.sentenceEn: The table was laden with delicious delicacies, perfect in colour, aroma and taste.

啃.meaning: 一点一点地用力咬硬的东西。
啃.sentence: 小狗趴在墙角，专心地啃着一根大骨头。
啃.sentenceEn: The puppy lay in the corner, intently gnawing on a big bone.

入侵.meaning: 敌人或有害事物侵入境内或某一范围。
入侵.sentence: 边防战士日夜守卫，绝不让敌人轻易入侵。
入侵.sentenceEn: The frontier guards keep watch day and night, never letting the enemy invade easily.

砍伐.sentence: 过度砍伐森林，会让水土流失变得更加严重。
砍伐.sentenceEn: Excessive felling of forests makes soil erosion even more severe.

栖息.meaning: 鸟类等停留、歇息；泛指居住、停留。
栖息.en: to perch; to roost; to inhabit
栖息.sentence: 黄昏时分，成群的白鹭飞回树林栖息。
栖息.sentenceEn: At dusk, flocks of egrets fly back to the woods to roost.

牢记.meaning: 牢牢地记在心里，不忘记。
牢记.en: to keep firmly in mind; to remember well
牢记.sentence: 老师的教诲，他一直牢记在心，从不敢忘。
牢记.sentenceEn: He has always kept the teacher's guidance firmly in mind, never daring to forget it.

勿.meaning: 副词，表示禁止或劝阻，相当于“不要”。
勿.sentence: 墙上贴着一行字：请勿在公共场所大声喧哗。
勿.sentenceEn: A line on the wall read: please do not make loud noise in public places.

惩罚.meaning: 严厉地处罚，使犯错的人受到教训。
惩罚.sentence: 老师并没有惩罚他，而是耐心地讲清了道理。
惩罚.sentenceEn: The teacher did not punish him but patiently explained the reasoning.

恶劣.sentence: 尽管天气恶劣，救援队仍然连夜赶往灾区。
恶劣.sentenceEn: Despite the terrible weather, the rescue team rushed to the disaster area through the night.

浸泡.meaning: 把东西放在液体中泡一段时间。
浸泡.sentence: 妈妈把黄豆浸泡了一夜，准备第二天磨豆浆。
浸泡.sentenceEn: Mum soaked the soybeans overnight, ready to grind soy milk the next day.

牺牲.meaning: 为正义的目的舍弃生命；放弃个人利益。
牺牲.en: to sacrifice; lay down one's life
牺牲.sentence: 为了保护战友，他毫不犹豫地牺牲了自己。
牺牲.sentenceEn: To protect his comrades, he sacrificed himself without hesitation.

锐减.sentence: 由于栖息地被破坏，这种鸟的数量近年来锐减。
锐减.sentenceEn: Owing to habitat destruction, the number of these birds has plummeted in recent years.

保育.meaning: 保护并培育（动植物或幼儿）。
保育.sentence: 这个海洋保育中心专门救治受伤的海龟。
保育.sentenceEn: This marine conservation centre specializes in treating injured sea turtles.

储存.meaning: 把东西积存起来，留待日后使用。
储存.sentence: 松鼠在冬天来临前储存了大量的松果。
储存.sentenceEn: The squirrel stored a large number of pine cones before winter arrived.

身躯.sentence: 他用魁梧的身躯挡在孩子前面，护住了他们。
身躯.sentenceEn: He shielded the children with his burly body, keeping them safe.

侵蚀.meaning: 逐渐损坏或腐蚀；逐步消减。
侵蚀.sentence: 海浪经年累月地侵蚀着岸边的礁石。
侵蚀.sentenceEn: Year after year, the waves eroded the reef rocks along the shore.

空隙.meaning: 中间空着的地方；空闲的时间。
空隙.en: a gap; a crack; a spare moment
空隙.sentence: 阳光透过树叶间的空隙洒落在地上。
空隙.sentenceEn: Sunlight scattered onto the ground through the gaps between the leaves.

堤.meaning: 沿江河湖海修筑的挡水构筑物。
堤.en: a dyke; an embankment; a levee
堤.sentence: 洪水来临前，村民连夜加固了河边的长堤。
堤.sentenceEn: Before the flood came, the villagers reinforced the long embankment by the river through the night.

窥视.sentence: 他躲在门后，偷偷窥视着屋里的动静。
窥视.sentenceEn: Hiding behind the door, he secretly spied on what was happening in the room.

宣布.sentence: 校长在升旗礼上宣布了这个振奋人心的好消息。
宣布.sentenceEn: At the flag-raising ceremony, the principal announced the heartening good news.

狩猎.sentence: 在古代，狩猎不仅是为了食物，也是一种训练。
狩猎.sentenceEn: In ancient times, hunting was not only for food but also a form of training.

饥饿.sentence: 难民们长期忍受着饥饿和疾病的折磨。
饥饿.sentenceEn: The refugees long endured the torment of hunger and disease.

糟蹋.meaning: 浪费或损坏东西；不爱惜。
糟蹋.sentence: 这么好的食物随手扔掉，实在是糟蹋。
糟蹋.sentenceEn: Throwing away such good food is truly a waste.

毁灭.sentence: 一场大火几乎毁灭了整片古老的森林。
毁灭.sentenceEn: A great fire nearly destroyed the entire ancient forest.

罪魁祸首.meaning: 作恶犯罪的头子；造成祸患的主要原因。
罪魁祸首.en: the chief culprit; the main cause of disaster
罪魁祸首.sentence: 调查发现，乱砍滥伐才是这场水灾的罪魁祸首。
罪魁祸首.sentenceEn: The investigation found that reckless deforestation was the chief culprit behind the flood.

竞争.meaning: 为了胜过对方而相互争胜。
竞争.sentence: 市场竞争十分激烈，企业必须不断创新。
竞争.sentenceEn: Market competition is fierce, and companies must keep innovating.

袭击.meaning: 出其不意地打击或攻打。
袭击.sentence: 寒流突然袭击，气温一夜之间骤降。
袭击.sentenceEn: A cold wave struck suddenly, and the temperature plunged overnight.

违背.meaning: 违反；不遵守诺言、原则等。
违背.en: to violate; go against; break a promise
违背.sentence: 他宁可吃亏，也绝不违背自己的良心。
违背.sentenceEn: He would rather suffer a loss than ever go against his own conscience.

拼搏.en: to struggle hard; go all out
拼搏.sentence: 运动员们在赛场上奋勇拼搏，为荣誉而战。
拼搏.sentenceEn: The athletes fought hard on the field, competing for glory.

联盟.meaning: 为共同目的结成的团体或组织。
联盟.en: an alliance; a league; a union
联盟.sentence: 几个小国结成联盟，共同抵御外来的侵略。
联盟.sentenceEn: Several small states formed an alliance to jointly resist foreign aggression.

迄今.en: up to now; to date; so far
迄今.sentence: 这座古桥迄今已有八百多年的历史。
迄今.sentenceEn: This ancient bridge has a history of over eight hundred years to date.

蜿蜒.meaning: 形容山脉、河流、道路等弯弯曲曲地延伸。
蜿蜒.sentence: 一条小路蜿蜒着伸向远处的山谷。
蜿蜒.sentenceEn: A small path wound its way toward the distant valley.

诸多.meaning: 许多；很多，多用于书面语。
诸多.en: many; numerous; a great deal of
诸多.sentence: 这项工程在施工过程中遇到了诸多困难。
诸多.sentenceEn: This project encountered numerous difficulties during construction.

古迹.meaning: 古代留存下来的遗址、建筑物等。
古迹.en: a historic site; a place of historical interest
古迹.sentence: 这座城市保留了许多珍贵的名胜古迹。
古迹.sentenceEn: This city has preserved many precious scenic spots and historic sites.

雕刻.meaning: 在材料上刻出形象或花纹。
雕刻.sentence: 老艺人在一块木头上雕刻出栩栩如生的飞鸟。
雕刻.sentenceEn: The old craftsman carved a lifelike bird out of a block of wood.

啧啧称奇.meaning: 咂嘴表示赞叹，称赞奇妙。
啧啧称奇.en: click one's tongue in wonder; marvel at
啧啧称奇.sentence: 看到这件巧夺天工的玉雕，游客们无不啧啧称奇。
啧啧称奇.sentenceEn: Seeing this exquisitely crafted jade carving, the tourists all marvelled at it.

赞叹.sentence: 大家纷纷赞叹这幅画构图巧妙、色彩动人。
赞叹.sentenceEn: Everyone praised the painting for its clever composition and moving colours.

底蕴.meaning: 内里蕴含的丰富内涵，多指文化、学识。
底蕴.en: deep cultural heritage; rich inner substance
底蕴.sentence: 这座古城有着深厚的文化底蕴，处处可见历史的痕迹。
底蕴.sentenceEn: This ancient city has a profound cultural heritage, with traces of history everywhere.

金碧辉煌.meaning: 形容建筑物等异常华丽，光彩夺目。
金碧辉煌.sentence: 走进这座金碧辉煌的宫殿，众人都看得目瞪口呆。
金碧辉煌.sentenceEn: Stepping into the magnificent palace, everyone was dumbfounded.

颇.meaning: 副词，表示程度相当高，相当于“很”“相当”。
颇.sentence: 他对这件事颇有研究，说起来头头是道。
颇.sentenceEn: He has studied this matter quite a bit and speaks about it clearly and logically.

独树一帜.meaning: 比喻独自创出新风格或新派别，与众不同。
独树一帜.en: develop a unique style of one's own; stand out distinctively
独树一帜.sentence: 他的画风独树一帜，在众多作品中一眼就能认出。
独树一帜.sentenceEn: His painting style is distinctive and stands out at a glance among many works.

赋税.meaning: 田地税和其他捐税的总称。
赋税.sentence: 古时遇上灾年，朝廷往往会减免百姓的赋税。
赋税.sentenceEn: In ancient times, in years of disaster the court would often reduce the people's taxes.

揭竿而起.en: rise up in revolt; raise the banner of rebellion
揭竿而起.sentence: 不堪暴政的压迫，百姓终于揭竿而起。
揭竿而起.sentenceEn: Unable to bear the oppression of tyranny, the people finally rose up in revolt.

暴虐.sentence: 这个暴虐的君主滥用刑罚，弄得民不聊生。
暴虐.sentenceEn: This tyrannical ruler abused punishment, leaving the people in misery.

葬送.meaning: 断送；使彻底失去前途、生命等。
葬送.en: to ruin; spell the end of; throw away
葬送.sentence: 一时的冲动，可能会葬送他的大好前程。
葬送.sentenceEn: A moment's impulse could ruin his bright future.

推卸.meaning: 不肯承担责任，推给别人。
推卸.sentence: 出了问题，他不但不反省，反而想推卸责任。
推卸.sentenceEn: When a problem arose, far from reflecting, he tried to shirk responsibility.

停滞.meaning: 停下来，不再发展或流动。
停滞.en: to stagnate; be at a standstill
停滞.sentence: 由于资金短缺，工程一度陷入停滞。
停滞.sentenceEn: Owing to a shortage of funds, the project once ground to a standstill.

趾高气扬.meaning: 形容骄傲自满，得意忘形的样子。
趾高气扬.sentence: 赢了一场比赛，他就趾高气扬，目中无人。
趾高气扬.sentenceEn: After winning one match, he became arrogant and looked down on everyone.

谦逊.sentence: 他虽然成就斐然，为人却十分谦逊。
谦逊.sentenceEn: Although his achievements were remarkable, he was very modest in person.

梦寐以求.meaning: 睡梦中都在追求，形容愿望迫切。
梦寐以求.en: long for; dream of; yearn for
梦寐以求.sentence: 进入这所名校，是他梦寐以求的目标。
梦寐以求.sentenceEn: Getting into this prestigious school was the goal he had long dreamed of.

昌盛.sentence: 人人都盼望国家繁荣昌盛，百姓安居乐业。
昌盛.sentenceEn: Everyone hopes the nation will be prosperous and the people will live and work in peace.

协作.sentence: 这个项目需要多个部门密切协作才能完成。
协作.sentenceEn: This project requires close collaboration among several departments to complete.

论坛.meaning: 公开发表议论、交流意见的场所或平台。
论坛.sentence: 这次国际论坛吸引了来自各国的专家学者。
论坛.sentenceEn: This international forum attracted experts and scholars from many countries.

毋庸讳言.en: needless to conceal; it must frankly be said
毋庸讳言.sentence: 毋庸讳言，这次失败主要是准备不足造成的。
毋庸讳言.sentenceEn: It must frankly be said that this failure was mainly due to insufficient preparation.

棘手.meaning: 形容事情难办，像被刺扎手一样。
棘手.sentence: 这是个十分棘手的问题，谁都不愿意接手。
棘手.sentenceEn: This is a very thorny problem that no one is willing to take on.

里程碑.meaning: 比喻在历史进程中可作为标志的重大事件。
里程碑.sentence: 这项发明是科技发展史上的一座里程碑。
里程碑.sentenceEn: This invention is a milestone in the history of technological development.

开拓.meaning: 开辟；扩展疆土、领域、思路等。
开拓.sentence: 一代代先辈艰苦创业，为我们开拓了广阔的天地。
开拓.sentenceEn: Generation after generation of forebears worked hard to open up a vast world for us.

先驱.meaning: 走在前面引领的人；开创事业的人。
先驱.en: a pioneer; a forerunner; a trailblazer
先驱.sentence: 他是这一领域当之无愧的先驱，启发了无数后来者。
先驱.sentenceEn: He is a worthy pioneer in this field, inspiring countless who came after.

气馁.sentence: 即使屡次失败，他也从不气馁。
气馁.sentenceEn: Even after repeated failures, he never lost heart.

出类拔萃.meaning: 形容才能、品德等超出同类之上。
出类拔萃.en: stand out from one's peers; be outstanding
出类拔萃.sentence: 在众多选手中，她的表现出类拔萃，赢得了冠军。
出类拔萃.sentenceEn: Among the many contestants, her performance stood out and won the championship.

韧性.meaning: 柔软而结实，不易折断的性质；比喻顽强持久的精神。
韧性.sentence: 面对挫折，他展现出惊人的韧性，从不轻言放弃。
韧性.sentenceEn: In the face of setbacks, he showed astonishing resilience and never gave up easily.

浩瀚.meaning: 形容水势盛大；引申为广大、繁多。
浩瀚.sentence: 我们仰望着浩瀚的星空，感到自己无比渺小。
浩瀚.sentenceEn: Gazing up at the vast starry sky, we felt incomparably small.

天方夜谭.meaning: 比喻虚诞、离奇的言论或荒诞不经的事情。
天方夜谭.en: a fantastic tale; an incredible story
天方夜谭.sentence: 在百年前，登上月球简直是天方夜谭。
天方夜谭.sentenceEn: A century ago, landing on the moon was simply a fantasy.

贬.meaning: 降低官职或评价；指出缺点，与“褒”相对。
贬.sentence: 这位官员因直言进谏，被贬到偏远的小城。
贬.sentenceEn: For speaking out frankly, the official was demoted to a remote small town.

粮食.meaning: 供食用的谷物、豆类等的统称。
粮食.sentence: 农民辛勤耕作，为全国提供了充足的粮食。
粮食.sentenceEn: The farmers toiled to provide ample grain for the whole country.

满腔.meaning: 充满整个胸膛，形容某种情感充沛。
满腔.en: one's heart filled with; a bosom full of
满腔.sentence: 他满腔热情地投入到志愿服务中。
满腔.sentenceEn: He threw himself into volunteer service with wholehearted enthusiasm.

霜.meaning: 接近地面的水汽遇冷凝结成的白色冰晶。
霜.sentence: 深秋的清晨，草地上结了一层薄薄的霜。
霜.sentenceEn: On a late-autumn morning, a thin layer of frost formed on the grass.

遣.sentence: 将军连夜遣人快马送去了急报。
遣.sentenceEn: The general dispatched a rider through the night to deliver the urgent report.

挽.meaning: 拉；卷起；设法使局势好转。
挽.en: to pull; roll up; retrieve; save
挽.sentence: 眼看局面就要失控，他想尽办法力挽狂澜。
挽.sentenceEn: As the situation was about to spin out of control, he did all he could to turn the tide.

豪迈.meaning: 气魄大，胸怀宽广，不拘小节。
豪迈.sentence: 他用豪迈的语气说出了心中的志向。
豪迈.sentenceEn: In a bold tone he declared the ambition in his heart.

慷慨激昂.meaning: 形容情绪、语调激动昂扬，充满正气。
慷慨激昂.sentence: 他在台上慷慨激昂地发表演说，听众深受感染。
慷慨激昂.sentenceEn: He gave an impassioned speech on stage, deeply moving the audience.

勉励.sentence: 老师常以这句名言勉励我们勇往直前。
勉励.sentenceEn: The teacher often used this famous saying to encourage us to forge ahead.

朝廷.meaning: 君主时代帝王处理政务的地方；指中央政府。
朝廷.en: the imperial court; the royal government
朝廷.sentence: 这道奏折很快被送进了朝廷，呈到皇帝面前。
朝廷.sentenceEn: The memorial was soon sent to the court and presented before the emperor.

笔锋.meaning: 毛笔的尖端；指文章的气势或议论的锋芒。
笔锋.en: the tip of a writing brush; the thrust of one's writing
笔锋.sentence: 这篇评论笔锋犀利，直指问题的要害。
笔锋.sentenceEn: This commentary is sharp in style, striking straight at the heart of the problem.

扎.sentence: 他一头扎进图书馆，整整一天都没出来。
扎.sentenceEn: He plunged into the library and did not come out the whole day.

喧腾.meaning: 喧闹沸腾；形容人声鼎沸、热闹非凡。
喧腾.en: noise and bustle; a hubbub; clamour
喧腾.sentence: 球进的那一刻，整个看台顿时喧腾起来。
喧腾.sentenceEn: The moment the goal went in, the whole stand erupted into a clamour.

感悟.en: to realize; come to understand; gain insight
感悟.sentence: 经历了这件事，他对人生有了更深的感悟。
感悟.sentenceEn: After going through this, he gained a deeper understanding of life.

崭新.sentence: 经过翻修，这座老校舍焕然一新，成了崭新的模样。
崭新.sentenceEn: After renovation, the old schoolhouse took on a completely new, brand-new look.

迥然.meaning: 形容差别很大，截然不同。
迥然.sentence: 这对双胞胎长得相似，性格却迥然不同。
迥然.sentenceEn: The twins look alike, yet their personalities are vastly different.

崎岖.meaning: 形容山路高低不平，难走；比喻处境艰难。
崎岖.sentence: 山路崎岖难行，他们走走停停，花了大半天才到山顶。
崎岖.sentenceEn: The mountain road was rugged and hard to walk; stopping and starting, they took most of the day to reach the summit.

仰望.en: to look up (at); look up to
仰望.sentence: 夜里，他独自躺在草地上仰望着满天繁星。
仰望.sentenceEn: At night, he lay alone on the grass, gazing up at the star-filled sky.

地位.meaning: 人或团体在社会关系中所处的位置。
地位.sentence: 经过多年努力，她在公司里确立了重要的地位。
地位.sentenceEn: After years of effort, she established an important position in the company.

飞逝.meaning: 形容时间等很快地过去。
飞逝.sentence: 光阴飞逝，转眼又是一年。
飞逝.sentenceEn: Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye another year had passed.

奔赴.meaning: 朝某个目的地很快地赶去。
奔赴.en: to rush to; hurry toward; head for
奔赴.sentence: 接到命令后，战士们立刻奔赴前线。
奔赴.sentenceEn: On receiving the order, the soldiers immediately rushed to the front.

负责.meaning: 担负责任；做事尽职认真。
负责.en: to be responsible for; be conscientious
负责.sentence: 这次活动由学生会负责组织和安排。
负责.sentenceEn: This event was organized and arranged by the student council.

担当.sentence: 面对困难，他勇于担当，从不推脱。
担当.sentenceEn: In the face of difficulty, he readily took responsibility and never shirked.

接待.sentence: 酒店的工作人员热情地接待了每一位来宾。
接待.sentenceEn: The hotel staff warmly received every guest.

长处.en: a strong point; a merit; a forte
长处.sentence: 我们应该多看别人的长处，少挑别人的毛病。
长处.sentenceEn: We should look more at others’ strengths and find fewer faults.

优势.meaning: 比对方有利的形势或条件。
优势.sentence: 在这场比赛中，主队占据了明显的优势。
优势.sentenceEn: In this match, the home team held a clear advantage.

合格.meaning: 符合规定的标准或要求。
合格.sentence: 只有各项指标都达标，产品才算合格。
合格.sentenceEn: Only when all indicators meet the standard is a product considered up to par.

举动.sentence: 他这个突然的举动，让在场的人都愣住了。
举动.sentenceEn: His sudden move left everyone present stunned.

教导.sentence: 老师的谆谆教导，我至今铭记在心。
教导.sentenceEn: I still keep my teacher’s earnest guidance in my heart to this day.
